params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { columns: [{ key, label, type?, align?, sortable?, hidePhone? }], filters?: [{ key, type, label, options? }], actions?: [{ label, href?, variant? }], empty?: { heading?, description? }, pageSize? }.

notes: Hand-written (issue #366): load(query) is a callback property, set from script, so the component (PkListPage<TItem>) hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot, bridge setCallback) that calls the Load parameter, Func<PkListRequest, Task<PkListResult<TItem>>>. Not a mapped param: the generator only maps props, slots and events. rowHref is synchronous in the element and cannot cross the interop boundary; use Config actions or a row-click handler (later step).
